title: Google's Secret Zelda Easter Egg: What Is It?
description: Google has launched a fun Legend of Zelda Easter egg that transports users back to 1998 when searching for Ocarina of Time. Source: Ars Technica This is a short news summary about Google's latest Easter egg.
narration: Google has a secret Zelda Easter egg. According to Ars Technica, searching for Ocarina of Time on Google triggers a retro Legend of Zelda Easter egg that transports you back to 1998. Zelda fans should search Ocarina of Time to find this fun interactive tribute. The feature is a fun trip back to nineteen ninety eight. Google surprises users with this nostalgic trip back to 1998.
